title: Bunker Blitz
description: Old-school, fast and a little bit sweaty. Rogue security drones have taken over the bunker and it's on you to clear them out, wave after wave. Scouts are quick, Brutes take a beating, and there's always more of them than last time. Grab ammo and med-packs where you can.
instructions: Click the game to lock your mouse. WASD to move, mouse to aim, click or Space to shoot, Shift to sprint. Arrow keys turn too. On a phone: left thumb moves, right thumb looks, tap FIRE.
